methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen wet tile saws spanning compact 4-3/8 in. handheld cutters to 10 in. bridge/rail saws and a 30 in. bridge saw, verified 2026-08-05 against manufacturer product pages (DeWalt, Ryobi, SKIL, QEP, Rubi, MK Diamond, Delta Machinery, Leegol Electric) and their hosted manuals/spec sheets, corroborated by major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Amazon, Burns Tools, Trick-Tools, Acme Tools, Toolnut, Stone Tooling, Zoro) where the manufacturer's own page did not display price or a full spec table; two seed items could not be verified as real current products and were replaced with the closest verifiable equivalent (noted per-product in provenance), and several numeric fields are left null rather than guessed where no fetched source stated them.

products.name: DeWalt D24000S 10 in. Wet Tile Saw with Stand
products.priceNote: DeWalt MSRP per federatedtool.com/toolup.com listings; street price commonly seen $899-$1,049 across distributors (Gulf Coast Flooring, ToolUp, Tile Outlets of America)

specs.miter_bevel_range: integrated 45° and 22.5° miter guides on rip fence; rail/bridge design, no table bevel tilt

products.provenance: DeWalt's own product page and retailer spec sheets (ToolOrbit, Tools4Flooring, Amazon) confirm a 15A/1.5 HP motor, 10 in. blade, 24 in. rip capacity (some retailers cite up to 25-28 in. with the plunge/extension technique, but 24 in. is the figure on DeWalt's own spec sheet), 18 in. diagonal cut, 3-1/8 in. max depth of cut, and 69 lb weight (marketed as the lightest 10 in. wet tile saw in its class). No-load blade RPM is not published on any fetched source, so it is left null rather than estimated.

products.name: DeWalt DWC860W 4-3/8 in. Corded Wet/Dry Handheld Tile Cutter
products.priceNote: Current retail (Burns Tools); Lowe's and Home Depot list the same model but blocked direct price fetch
products.provenance: DeWalt's own product page and Lowe's/Amazon listings confirm 10.8A (120V) motor, 13,000 RPM no-load, 4-3/8 in. diamond blade cutting up to 1-3/8 in. deep wet or dry, 45° bevel, integrated 13 in. water line/regulator, and 6.6 lb weight. As a handheld freehand saw it has no fixed table, rip fence, or diagonal-cut spec, so those fields are null rather than not-applicable placeholders. Motor is rated only in amps (10.8A / ~1,300W), never horsepower, on any fetched source, so motor_power_hp is null.

products.name: Ryobi WS722 7 in. 4.8 Amp Tabletop Wet Tile Saw
products.provenance: Ryobi's own product page confirms the $119.00 price and 0.75 HP / 4.8A motor at 3,450 RPM. Cutting capacity (20 in. rip, 13 in. diagonal, 1-1/4 in. max tile thickness), tilting table with 22.5°/45° bevel stops, 19.5 x 17.5 in. table footprint, and 27.03 lb weight are documented in the manufacturer's manual (ManualsLib) and reproduced on Tools In Action and Pawn America listings.

products.name: SKIL 3540-02 7 in. Wet Tile Saw
products.priceNote: Current retail (Toolnut); Lowe's/Walmart list the same model but blocked direct price fetch
products.provenance: SKIL's own page and Lowe's/Walmart listings confirm a 120V/4.2A motor, 7 in. blade, stainless-steel top, adjustable rip fence with miter gauge, and 0-45° bevel. Rated tile capacity is documented as "supports tiles up to 12 x 12 in." with a cross-cut capacity of 7.75 in. and diagonal-cut capacity of 7.25 in. per the manufacturer spec sheet -- notably small for a 7 in. saw because the fixed table (no sliding extension) caps usable cut length; max_rip_cut_in uses the 12 in. tile-support figure as the more representative rip figure. No horsepower, no-load RPM, or maximum tile thickness figure was found on any fetched source, so those fields are left null. Dimensions 14 x 13.25 in. and 18 lb weight per SKIL's spec sheet.

products.name: QEP 22650Q (650XT) 3/4 HP 7 in. Wet Tile Saw
products.priceNote: Sold at Home Depot and Amazon; direct price fetch was blocked (403/500 errors) on every retailer page attempted, so priceUsd is left null rather than guessed
products.provenance: McCoy's Building Supply spec sheet and QEP's own 700XT product page confirm 120V/4.8A/550W, 3/4-peak HP motor at 3,600 RPM, 5/8 in. arbor, 1-1/4 in. depth of cut, steel table/frame with rubber feet, water recirculation reservoir, and 22.5°/45° table-tilt bevel. QEP's marketing copy states rip and diagonal cut as "Unlimited" (an open sliding rip fence rather than a fixed maximum), which is recorded as the literal manufacturer-stated value rather than a numeric guess. Dimensions 20.08 x 15.74 x 9.88 in. and 19.2 lb weight per the same spec sheet.

products.name: QEP 83250Q Professional Bridge Saw, 30 in.
products.priceNote: Representative professional-bridge-saw list price (Pro Supply Center / distributor pricing); QEP's own consumer site does not display this SKU's price and Home Depot blocked direct fetch. Retailer noted the model as recently superseded by the QEP 83200Q 24 in. bridge saw.

specs.miter_bevel_range: adjustable pivoting rail switches between 45° and 90° miter cuts
specs.table_size: 37 in. L x 18 in. W x 47.5 in. H (with folding stand)

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model "QEP 83250" (no suffix) as a 10 in. saw does not exist in QEP's current or historical catalog; the actual product at that item number is the QEP 83250Q, a 30 in. folding-stand professional bridge saw (positioned as the replacement for the discontinued Roberts 83230). Pro Supply Center's distributor listing (reproducing QEP's own spec sheet) documents an 8 in. continuous-rim diamond blade, 1-1/3 HP / 120V-60Hz / 11.3A / 1,350W motor at 3,420 RPM, 30 in. rip and 22 in. diagonal cut capacity, 1-3/8 in. depth of cut, dual water ports, ball-bearing cutting-head assembly, and 116.6 lb shipping weight with the folding wheeled stand. QEP's own product listing confirms this SKU has since been superseded by the 83200Q 24 in. bridge saw; retained here as the entry a researcher would find under the seed item number.

products.name: Rubi DU-200 EVO Tile Saw (120V/60Hz USA)
products.priceNote: Current retail (Stone Tooling), listed as reduced from list price by $80; Rubi.com does not display consumer pricing

specs.miter_bevel_range: head hinges to 45° for miter cuts
specs.table_size: 46.125 in. L x 15.375 in. W x 40.125 in. H (folding-leg working height)

products.provenance: Rubi's own US product page confirms the 120V/60Hz USA spec: 1.1 HP (800W) direct-drive motor with thermal protector, 3,200 RPM (vs. 2,915 RPM on the 230V/50Hz export version), 8 in. blade (7-7/8 in. on the export version), 25-5/8 in. max rip cut, 17-3/4 x 17-3/4 in. diagonal cut, 1-3/8 in. cutting height, folding-leg chassis with wheels, and 49.6 lb net weight. This is the base DU-200 EVO (650mm-class head travel); Rubi also sells a longer-rail DU-200 EVO 850 sibling with greater rip capacity, not reflected in this entry.

products.name: MK Diamond MK-370EXP 7 in. Wet Tile Saw
products.priceNote: Current retail (Toolbox Supply); price includes bundled MK-100 diamond blade and submersible water pump
products.provenance: MK Diamond's own product page and its hosted owner's manual confirm a 1-1/4 HP, 120V high-torque universal motor, 7 in. wet-cutting blade, 18 in. rip / 13 in. diagonal cut capacity, ability to cut 2 in. thick material in one pass, built-in 45° miter and plunge-cut capability, chrome guide-bar/linear-bearing carriage, MK-Safeswitch key interlock, and 33 lb weight. No no-load RPM figure or table-dimension spec was found on either fetched source, so those fields are left null.

products.name: Delta Cruzer 96-107 7 in. Wet Tile/Stone Saw
products.priceNote: Current retail (Acme Tools), base saw without stand; bundles with scissor or folding stand are priced higher

specs.table_size: 33.75 in. L x 32.75 in. W x 19.75 in. H (overall, saw footprint)

products.provenance: Delta Machinery's own product page and Lowe's listing confirm a 13A/120V direct-drive motor at 5,300 RPM, 7 in. wheel with 5/8 in. arbor, 2-3/8 in. max depth of cut at 90° (1-1/4 in. at 45°), 26 in. max rip cut, 18 in. max diagonal square-tile capacity, 12-bearing precision rail system, and plunge cutting for V-cap and cutout work. Amperage is documented but no horsepower rating is published on any fetched source, so motor_power_hp is null. Weight (63 lb) and overall dimensions (33-3/4 x 32-3/4 x 19-3/4 in.) per Acme Tools/Toolmarts listings; the Cruzer line is positioned as a premium precision-rail saw, which is reflected in the higher price versus other 7 in. tabletop saws in this roster.

products.name: Chicago Electric 69275 10 in. Industrial Tile/Brick Saw
products.priceNote: Regular price per archived Harbor Freight promotional-coupon pages (2020-2021); live harborfreight.com product page returned a 403 error on direct fetch at research time, so current availability/pricing could not be reconfirmed

specs.miter_bevel_range: adjustable miter gauge (left/right of blade); bevel head adjustable, angle range not stated in fetched manual excerpt

products.provenance: Harbor Freight's own owner's manual (hosted on ManualsLib) confirms a 2.5 HP, 110V motor, 10 in. blade capacity, 3-1/2 in. max cutting depth at 0° (1-1/2 in. at 45°... recorded per manual pagination as 1-2 in., likely an OCR artifact for 1-1/2 in.), 24 in. max cutting length, 18 in. max diagonal tile size, built-in 3 GPM water pump, and removable ABS water tub. No-load RPM, table dimensions, and net weight were not present in the fetched manual excerpt. Price and current-availability status are sourced from an archived promotional coupon page (Jan 2021); Harbor Freight's live product page blocked direct fetch (403), so the item's present-day listing status is unconfirmed and this entry should be treated as possibly discontinued/rotated out of the Chicago Electric line.

products.name: Leegol Electric 7 in. Wet Tile Saw
products.provenance: Leegol Electric's own product page confirms a 120V/60Hz/5A motor at 3,550 RPM no-load, 7 in. diamond blade with 5/8 in. arbor, chrome-plated 15-3/4 x 16-1/2 in. table tilting 0-45°, adjustable rip fence with miter gauge, water-cooling reservoir, and max cutting capacity of 1 in. thick x 12 in. wide material (used here as max_rip_cut_in). No horsepower rating or product weight is published on the manufacturer's page or the Amazon listing, so those fields are left null. Diagonal-cut capacity is not separately specified.

products.name: Goldblatt G02772 7 in. Wet Tile Saw with Aluminum Table
products.priceNote: Current eBay authorized-listing price (range seen $121.89-$123.99); also sold on Amazon, Newegg, and Zoro (Prime-Line/Goldblatt co-branded)
products.provenance: SUBSTITUTED FROM SEED: no Goplus-branded wet tile saw could be located in Goplus's current catalog (goplusus.com's own site search for "tile saw" returns only a manual, non-powered tile cutter) or on Amazon/Walmart; Goplus does not appear to currently sell a powered wet tile saw. Replaced with the closest comparable low-cost import-brand 7 in. tabletop wet tile saw, the Goldblatt G02772, confirmed via Amazon/eBay/Newegg/Zoro listings at 4.6A/120V, 3,590 RPM max, 7 in. blade with 5/8 in. arbor, cast-aluminum table (18.1 x 18.9 in.), 0-45° tilting bevel table, water reservoir, and 1-3/16 in. max tile thickness. No horsepower rating, rip/diagonal cut capacity, or product weight was found on any fetched listing, so those fields are left null.

products.name: Kobalt KWS B72-06 7 in. Wet Tabletop Sliding Table Tile Saw
products.priceNote: Current retail (Ductmall); Lowe's carries the same model line but blocked direct price fetch
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: no Kobalt model "KWS B36-06" could be located across Lowe's, ManualsLib, eBay, or general search -- Kobalt's actual sliding-table tile saw lineup uses model codes KWS B7-06, KWS B72-06, KWS S7-06, KWS S72-06, and KWS S102-06. The seed was replaced with the closest matching real product, the KWS B72-06 (7 in., 6A, bottom-mount/box-style sliding table saw, 18 in. rip capacity, cuts 12 x 12 in. tile diagonally), confirmed on Lowe's and reproduced on Ductmall/eBay. Lowe's product page does not publish motor horsepower, no-load RPM, maximum tile thickness, table dimensions, or a bevel/miter angle range for this SKU, so those fields are left null rather than assumed from the similar KWS S7-06/S72-06 stand-equipped siblings.
